# Post-Deploy Review Template

## Change

Identify the change, commit, PR, and OpenSpec artifact.

## Outcome

Summarize what shipped and whether acceptance criteria were met.

## Validation

List automated and manual checks performed after deploy.

## Observations

Record metrics, logs, user impact, and operational notes.

## Issues

Describe incidents, regressions, or follow-up defects.

## Follow-ups

List owners and next actions.
